content: Known-item query synthesis from titles/H1 and body snippets is the Azzopardi/de Rijke/Balog (SIGIR 2006/2007) simulated-query line, also used in pseudo-desktop personal-search work. Synthetic queries systematically reuse source wording, inflating lexical retrieval: PITFALLS.md cites a TU Delft thesis measuring Kendall tau 0.48-0.88 between synthetic and real system rankings and NFCorpus synthetic nDCG@10 0.92 vs 0.32 real. Mitigate with a content-word overlap budget and separate exact-term (title) vs paraphrased (body) categories, never averaged into one number.
